title: Enable verified workspace file creation from Chat
goal: Allow the default Agent to create a text file in its bounded Workspace through the existing policy-gated Skill and Module runtime, then verify persisted content.
context: WorkspaceReadTool and WorkspaceWriteTool are registered in the production composition root, but the default Skill/Agent manifests do not expose a create-file Skill and ModuleBackedSkillExecutor only adapts read-only workspace search. This leaves the capability unreachable from ordinary Chat requests.
forbidden_changes: Do not bypass user capability settings or ModuleRuntime policy checks.
Do not permit writes outside the existing bounded Workspace roots or support arbitrary shell execution.
Do not overwrite customized Agent.md or Skill.md files during migration.
Do not claim end-to-end success without a test proving the file was persisted and read back.
acceptance_criteria: Default Skill store installs a workspace.create-file Skill backed by the existing workspace.write Tool contract.
Chat input in the documented Vietnamese or English form is translated to a strict workspace.write invocation.
The default built-in Agent is migrated to include the new Skill only when its existing manifest is unchanged from the previous default.
The Skill executes through ModuleRuntime policy and reports success only when the file content is read-back verified.
Regression tests cover Agent scope and intent selection through ModuleRuntime, real temporary-workspace file persistence/read-back, and safe default-Agent migration.
verification: Confirm Swift package tests + repository integrity, validate-contract, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI gates.
recovery: Revert the single logical task commit if workspace path boundaries, policy checks, existing Skill execution, or customized Agent manifests regress.
